paragraphs: Philip Morris International Inc. is a Virginia holding company incorporated in 1987. In March 2008, we became a U.S. public company listed on the New York Stock Exchange and subject to the rules of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). We are a leading international consumer goods company, actively delivering a smoke-free future and evolving our portfolio for the long term to include products outside of the tobacco and nicotine sector. Our current product portfolio primarily consists of cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, nicotine pouch and e-vapor products. Since 2008, we have invested over $16 billion to develop, scientifically substantiate and commercialize innovative smoke-free products for adults who would otherwise continue to smoke, with the goal of completely ending the sale of cigarettes. This investment includes the building of world-class scientific assessment capabilities, notably in the areas of pre-clinical systems toxicology, clinical and behavioral research, as well as post-market studies. In November 2022, we acquired Swedish Match AB ("Swedish Match") – a leader in oral nicotine delivery – creating a global smoke-free combination led by the companies' IQOS and ZYN brands. As of April 30, 2024, we hold the full rights to commercialize IQOS in the U.S. after reaching an agreement to end our U.S. commercial relationship covering IQOS with Altria Group, Inc. in 2022. Following a robust science-based review, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") has authorized the marketing of Swedish Match's General snus and ZYN nicotine pouches and versions of PMI's IQOS devices and consumables - the first-ever such authorizations in their respective categories. Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk Tobacco Product ("MRTP") authorizations from the FDA. We describe the MRTP orders in more detail in the "Business Environment" section of Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.

With a strong foundation and significant expertise in life sciences, PMI has a long-term ambition to expand into wellness areas. The business strategy of our wellness unit, Aspeya, currently focuses on developing and commercializing primarily oral consumer wellness offerings. This includes medical and non-recreational cannabinoid products (including CBD), in line with applicable regulatory requirements, though any revenue related to cannabinoids is expected to be negligible in the near to medium term.
Smoke-Free Business ("SFB") is the term PMI uses to refer to all of its smoke-free products. SFB also includes wellness products, as well as consumer accessories, such as lighters and matches.

Smoke-free products (also referred to herein as "SFPs") is the term PMI uses to refer to all of its products that provide nicotine without combusting tobacco, such as heat-not-burn, e-vapor, and oral smokeless, and that therefore generate far lower levels of harmful chemicals. As such, these products have the potential to present less risk of harm versus continued smoking.

We have a range of SFPs in various stages of development, scientific assessment and commercialization. Our smoke-free products are designed for, and directed toward, current adult smokers and adult users of nicotine-containing products. We put significant effort to restrict access of our products from underage persons. We believe regulation must include measures designed to prevent youth initiation; and we also support and engage with relevant authorities to seek sensible regulation of flavors, mandated health warnings and minimum age laws.

Our IQOS smoke-free product brand portfolio includes heated tobacco and nicotine-containing vapor products. It uses a precisely controlled heating device into which a specially designed and proprietary tobacco unit is inserted and heated to generate an aerosol. Heated tobacco units ("HTUs") is the term we use to refer to heated tobacco consumables, which include our BLENDS, DELIA, HEETS, HEETS Creations (defined collectively as "HEETS"), SENTIA, TEREA, TEREA CRAFTED and TEREA Dimensions, as well as the KT&G-licensed brands, Fiit and Miix (outside of South Korea). HTUs also include zero tobacco heat-not-burn consumables (LEVIA). IQOS was first introduced in Nagoya, Japan, in 2014.

IQOS, ZYN and VEEV are the leading brands in our SFPs portfolio. As of December 31, 2025, our smoke-free products were available for sale in 106 markets. With regard to modern oral pouches, we increased our presence to 56 markets.

Our cigarettes are sold in approximately 170 markets, and in many of these markets they hold the number one or number two market share position. We have a wide range of premium, mid-price and low-price brands. Our portfolio comprises both international and local brands and is led by Marlboro, the world's best-selling international cigarette, which accounted for approximately 43% of our total 2025 cigarette shipment volume. Marlboro is complemented in the premium-price category by Parliament. Our other leading

international cigarette brands are Chesterfield, L&M, and Philip Morris. These five international cigarette brands contributed 81% of our cigarette shipment volume in 2025. We also own a number of important local cigarette brands, such as Dji Sam Soe and Sampoerna A in Indonesia, and Fortune and Jackpot in the Philippines.

We are a legal entity separate and distinct from our direct and indirect subsidiaries. Accordingly, our right, and thus the right of our creditors and stockholders, to participate in any distribution of the assets or earnings of any subsidiary is subject to the prior rights of creditors of such subsidiary, except to the extent that claims of our company itself as a creditor may be recognized. As a holding company, our principal sources of funds, including funds to make payment on our debt securities, are from the receipt of dividends and repayment of debt from our subsidiaries. Our principal wholly owned and majority-owned subsidiaries currently are not limited by long-term debt or other agreements in their ability to pay cash dividends or to make other distributions that are otherwise compliant with law, including governmental capital and foreign currency exchange controls.

Following the sale of Vectura Group Ltd. on December 31, 2024, we updated our segment reporting in January 2025 by including the ongoing Wellness results (previously referred to as Wellness & Healthcare) in the Europe segment. In addition, we renamed our "PMI Duty Free" business to "PMI Global Travel Retail" effective in the first quarter of 2025. As a result of this change, our segment that includes our duty free business was renamed East Asia, Australia & PMI Global Travel Retail ("EA, AU & PMI GTR").
As of December 31, 2025, our four geographical segments were as follows:

•Europe Region is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland, and covers all the European Union countries, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and also Ukraine, Moldova and Southeast Europe; it also includes our Wellness business;

•South and Southeast Asia, Commonwealth of Independent States, Middle East and Africa Region ("SSEA, CIS & MEA") is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Our business faces significant governmental actions aimed at increasing regulatory requirements with the goal of reducing or preventing the use of tobacco or nicotine-containing products.
The success of our business in the United States is dependent on an evolving legal and regulatory framework.
We face intense competition, and our failure to compete effectively could have a material adverse effect on our profitability and results of operations.
We may be unable to anticipate changes in adult consumer preferences.
The financial and business performance of our smoke-free products is less predictable than our cigarette business.

Our ability to achieve our strategic goals may be impaired if we fail to attract, motivate and retain the best global talent and effectively align our organizational design with the goals of our transformation.
We may be unsuccessful in our efforts to differentiate smoke-free products and cigarettes with respect to taxation.
Disruptions in the credit markets or changes to our credit ratings may adversely affect our business.
We may be required to write down assets due to impairment, which could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations or financial position.
Our business, results of operations, cash flows and financial position may be adversely impacted by the continuation and consequences of the war in Ukraine.
Risks related to the natural environment and related legal or regulatory developments may have a negative impact on our business and results of operations.
A prolonged disruption of facilities used to produce our products could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
We could decide, or be required to, recall products, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, reputation, results of operations, cash flows or financial position.
Because we have operations in numerous countries, our results may be adversely impacted by economic, regulatory and political developments, natural disasters, pandemics or conflicts.
A sustained period of elevated inflation across the markets in which we operate could result in higher operating and financing costs and lead to reduced demand for our products.
Litigation related to tobacco and nicotine products could substantially reduce our profitability and could severely impair our liquidity.
From time to time, we are subject to governmental investigations on a range of matters.
We may be unable to adequately protect our intellectual property rights, and disputes relating to intellectual property rights could harm our business.
The research, development, and commercialization of non-recreational cannabinoid products subjects the Company to legal, regulatory, reputational and other risks.
We increasingly use artificial intelligence-based solutions in our business, which could result in reputational harm, legal liability, and adversely affect our operating results.
We may not successfully identify, complete, or realize the benefits from strategic acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, or investments.

As communicated in the fourth quarter of 2025, with our smoke-free business now operating at scale across our regions, including substantial growth from our U.S. business, we have implemented an evolved organizational model with two primary business units: International and U.S. The updated organizational structure is designed to enhance our agility and to support our journey to become a smoke-free company under the leadership of Jacek Olczak, Group CEO of PMI. The four geographic segments have been replaced with three new reportable segments: International Smoke-Free, International Combustibles, and U.S. As of the first quarter of 2026, our reporting will reflect these changes.

Our net revenues and operating income are affected by various factors, including the volume and mix of products we sell, the price of our products and changes in currency exchange rates. Mix is a term used to refer to the proportionate value of premium-price brands to mid-price or low-price brands in any given market (product mix). paragraphs: Philip Morris International Inc. 是一家設立於維吉尼亞州的控股公司，於1987年成立。2008年3月，本公司成為美國上市的公開公司，並於紐約證券交易所上市，且受美國證券交易委員會（the "SEC"）規則所規範。本公司為國際消費性商品公司領導者，積極推動無煙未來，並長期發展產品組合，以包含煙草與尼古丁以外的產品。本公司目前的產品組合主要為香菸與無煙產品，包括加熱不燃燒、尼古丁口香包與電子煙產品。自2008年起，本公司已投資逾160億美元，用於開發、科學證據支持與商業化創新無煙產品，以服務那些否則會繼續吸菸的成人，目標為完全終止香菸的銷售。此投資包含建立世界級科學評估能力，特別是在預臨牀系統毒理學、臨牀與行為研究，以及上市後研究領域。2022年11月，本公司收購了瑞典Match AB（"Swedish Match"）——一家在口部尼古丁遞送領域的領導者，創造了一個全球無煙產品組合，由本公司IQOS與ZYN品牌領導。截至2024年4月30日，本公司在與Altria Group, Inc.於2022年達成協議終止美國商業關係後，已擁有完全權利商業化IQOS於美國。經過強而有力的科學評估後，美國食品藥物管理局（the "FDA"）已核准瑞典Match的General snus與ZYN尼古丁口香包，以及PMI的IQOS設備與消耗品版本——這是各自類別中首度核准。IQOS設備與消耗品版本與General snus也獲得了美國食品藥物管理局（the "FDA"）首度核准的改良風險煙草產品（"MRTP"）認證。本公司在第7項「業務環境」部分的「管理層討論與財務狀況及營運成果分析」中，更詳細說明瞭MRTP核准的內容。
以強大的基礎與深厚的專業知識於生命科學領域，PMI有長期擴展至健康產業的願景。本公司健康產業單位Aspeya的業務策略目前聚焦於開發與商業化主要為口服消費性健康產品。這包括醫療與非娛樂用途的 cannabinoids 產品（包括CBD），符合相關法規要求，不過與 cannabinoids 相關的收入預期在近中期將微乎其微。
無煙業務（"SFB"）為PMI所使用的術語，用以指稱所有無煙產品。SFB也包含健康產品，以及消費者配件，例如打火機與火柴。
無煙產品（也稱為"SFPs"）為PMI所使用的術語，用以指稱所有提供尼古丁而不燃燒煙草的產品，例如加熱不燃燒、電子煙與口部無煙產品，因此產生的有害化學物質遠低於傳統煙草產品。因此，這些產品有潛力比持續吸煙的風險更低。
本公司擁有各種處於不同開發、科學評估與商業化階段的SFPs。本公司無煙產品是為現有成人吸菸者與使用含尼古丁產品的成人所設計與針對的。本公司投入大量努力以防止未成年人取得本公司產品。本公司認為規範必須包含防止青少年開始吸菸的措施；本公司也支持並與相關主管機關合作，尋求對香料、強制健康警告與最低年齡法規的合理規範。

本公司IQOS無煙產品品牌組合包括加熱煙草與含尼古丁蒸汽產品。其使用一個精確控制的加熱裝置，將特別設計與專利的煙草單元插入並加熱，以產生氣霧。加熱煙草單元（"HTUs"）為本公司所使用的術語，用以指稱加熱煙草消耗品，包括本公司BLENDS、DELIA、HEETS、HEETS Creations（ collectively defined as "HEETS"）、SENTIA、TEREA、TEREA CRAFTED 和 TEREA Dimensions，以及KT&G授權的品牌Fiit 和 Miix（不包含韓國）。HTUs 也包括零煙草加熱不燃燒消耗品（LEVIA）。IQOS 於2014年首次在日本名古屋推出。
IQOS、ZYN 和 VEEV 是本公司 SFPs 組閤中的領導品牌。截至2025年12月31日，本公司無煙產品已在106個市場可供銷售。關於現代口部口香包，本公司已擴大至56個市場。
本公司香菸在約170個市場銷售，且在這些市場中，許多市場的市佔率為第一或第二。本公司擁有廣泛的高價、中價與低價品牌。本公司產品組合包含國際與本地品牌，並以 Marlboro 領先，這是全球最暢銷的國際香菸，佔本公司2025年香菸總發貨量約43%。Marlboro 在高價類別中由 Parliament 作為補充。本公司其他主要
國際香菸品牌為 Chesterfield、L&M 與 Philip Morris。這五個國際香菸品牌在 2025 年貢獻了我們香菸出貨量的 81%。我們也擁有若干重要的本地香菸品牌，例如印尼的 Dji Sam Soe 與 Sampoerna A，以及菲律賓的 Fortune 與 Jackpot。

本公司為一獨立法人的法律實體，與我們的直接及間接子公司皆為獨立且區別的。因此，本公司之權利，以及我們債權人與股東之權利，參與任何子公司資產或收益的分配，須先讓與該子公司債權人的權利，除非本公司本身作為債權人的聲請可被認可。作為控股公司，我們的主要資金來源，包括用以償還債務證券的資金，來自於子公司所支付的股息與償還債務。目前我們的主要 wholly owned 與 majority-owned 子公司，其現金股息支付或進行其他符合法律的分派能力，並未受到長期債務或其他協議的限制，包括政府資本與外匯管制。

在 2024 年 12 月 31 日出售 Vectura Group Ltd. 之後，我們於 2025 年 1 月更新了應報告分部的內容，將持續進行的 Wellness 結果（先前稱為 Wellness & Healthcare）納入 Europe 分部。此外，我們將 "PMI Duty Free" 事業更名為 "PMI Global Travel Retail"，自 2025 年第一季生效。因此，包含我們免稅商店業務的分部被更名為 East Asia, Australia & PMI Global Travel Retail（"EA, AU & PMI GTR"）。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的四個地理分部如下：
•Europe 分部位於瑞士洛桑，涵蓋所有歐盟國家、瑞士、英國，以及烏克蘭、摩爾多瓦與東南歐；也包含我們的 Wellness 事業；

paragraphs: 以下討論應配合本年度報告表 10-K 其他部分一同閱讀，包括第 8 項所載之合併財務報表及相關附註，以及第 1A 項所載可能影響未來結果之風險與警示因素。

本公司為一家國際領先的消費性商品公司，積極推動無煙未來。本公司正在長遠規劃中調整產品組合，以包含煙草及尼古丁以外的產品。目前本公司產品組合主要由香菸及無煙產品組成，包括加熱不燃燒、尼古丁口香包及電子煙產品。自2008年起，本公司已投資逾16 十億美元，用以研發、科學驗證及商業化創新無煙產品，以協助那些否則會持續吸菸的成人轉向使用無煙產品，目標為完全終止香菸的銷售。此投資包含建立世界級的科學評估能力，特別是在預臨牀系統毒理學、臨牀及行為研究，以及上市後研究等領域。2022年11月，本公司收購了瑞典煙草公司（Swedish Match AB）（"Swedish Match"）——一家在口腔尼古丁遞送領域的領導者，創造了一家全球無煙產品組合，由本公司IQOS及ZYN品牌領導。截至2024年4月30日，本公司已擁有在美國商業化IQOS的全部權利，此為本公司與Altria Group, Inc.在2022年達成協議，結束在美國IQOS的商業關係後所取得的權利。根據強而有力的科學基礎評審，美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）已核准瑞典煙草公司General snus及ZYN尼古丁口香包，以及本公司IQOS設備及消耗品的版本，這是其各自類別中首度獲得的核准。IQOS設備及消耗品的版本以及General snus也獲得了美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）首次頒發的修改風險煙草產品（"MRTP"）核准。本公司在本項目第7項的"業務環境"部分更詳細說明MRTP核准的內容。

於 2024 年 12 月 31 日出售 Vectura Group Ltd. 後，本公司於 2025 年 1 月更新了應報告分部，將持續之 Wellness 結果（先前稱為 Wellness & Healthcare）納入歐洲分部。此外，本公司於 2025 年第一季生效將 "PMI Duty Free" 事業更名為 "PMI Global Travel Retail"。此變更導致包含本公司免稅商店業務之分部更名為東亞、澳洲與 PMI Global Travel Retail（"EA, AU & PMI GTR"）。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司之四個地理分部如下：•歐洲地區，包括本公司之 Wellness 事業；
•南亞與東南亞、獨立國家聯合體、中東與非洲地區（"SSEA, CIS & MEA"）；
•東亞、澳洲與 PMI Global Travel Retail（"EA, AU & PMI GTR"）；以及

如於 2025 年第四季所說明，隨著本公司無煙業務在各區域已實現規模化運作，包括美國業務之顯著成長，本公司已實施進化後之組織架構，包含兩個主要業務單位：國際與美國。更新後之組織架構旨在提升本公司靈活性，並支持本公司在 Jacek Olczak，PMI 羣組首席執行官領導下成為無煙公司的旅程。此變更於 2026 年 1 月 1 日生效，因此本公司已相應調整應報告分部。四個地理分部已取代為三個新應報告分部：國際無煙、國際燃燒物與美國。自 2026 年第一季起，本公司之報告將反映此變更。
本公司香菸銷售於約 170 個市場，且在許多市場中佔據第一或第二市場佔有率。本公司擁有廣泛之高階、中階與低價品牌。本公司產品組合包含國際與本地品牌。
Smoke-Free Business ("SFB") 是 PMI 所使用的術語，用以指稱其所有無煙產品。SFB 也包含健康產品，以及消費者配件，例如打火機與火柴。
無煙產品（亦稱為 "SFPs"）是 PMI 所使用的術語，用以指稱其所有提供尼古丁而不燃燒煙草的產品，例如加熱不燃燒、電子煙霧和口香糖類產品，因此產生的有害化學物質遠低於傳統煙草產品。因此，這些產品有潛在的風險較低，相較於持續吸煙。
IQOS、ZYN 和 VEEV 是我們 SFPs 產品組閤中的領導品牌。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的無煙產品已在 106 個市場上架銷售。
憑藉在生命科學領域的強大基礎與豐富經驗，PMI 有長期擴展至健康領域的願景。我們健康業務單位 Aspeya 的商業策略目前聚焦於開發與商業化主要的口部消費者健康產品。這包括符合適用法規要求的醫療與非娛樂用途的 cannabinoids 產品（包括 CBD），不過與 cannabinoids 相關的收入預期在近至中短期內將微乎其微。

我們使用 "淨營收" 這個術語來指稱我們透過銷售產品所產生的營運收入，包括向客戶收取的運費與處理費，扣除銷售與促銷優惠後的金額，以及應課稅額。我們的淨營收與營運獲利會受到多種因素影響，包括我們銷售的產品數量與組合、產品價格以及貨幣兌換率的變動。"組合" 是指在任何特定市場中，高價品牌與中價或低價品牌價值的比例（產品組合）。"組合" 也可以指在較高獲利市場的運輸量與在較低獲利市場的運輸量的比例（地理組合）。
我們的銷售成本主要由：煙葉、非煙草原料、勞動與製造成本；運費與處理費；以及由第三方電子製造服務供應商所生產的設備成本組成。與設備保固計劃相關的預估成本，通常在與該筆收入相關的期間內，計入銷售成本中。

headings: 稅後香菸的消費在許多我們的市場持續下降。
我們的業務面臨許多政府的行動，旨在提高規範要求，以減少或防止使用含菸草或尼古丁產品。
我們在美國的業務成功取決於不斷演變的法律與規範架構。
我們面臨強烈的競爭，若我們無法有效競爭，可能對我們的獲利能力和營運成果造成重大不利影響。
我們可能無法預測成人消費者偏好的變化。
我們無煙產品的財務與業務表現不如我們的香菸業務可預測。
若我們無法吸引、激勵並留住最佳的全球人才，並有效將組織設計與我們轉型的目標對齊，我們實現戰略目標的能力可能受阻。
我們可能在區分無煙產品與香菸的稅收方面，無法成功實現差異化。
信用市場的動盪或信用評級的變更可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司可能因減損而需提列資產減損，這可能會對本公司營業成果或財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
烏克蘭戰爭的持續及其後果可能對本公司業務、營業成果、現金流量及財務狀況產生不利影響。
與自然環境相關的風險及相關法律或法規的發展變動，可能對本公司業務及營業成果產生負面影響。
用以生產本公司產品的設施若發生持續性中斷，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營業成果產生重大不利影響。
本公司可能決定或被要求召回產品，這可能會對本公司業務、聲譽、營業成果、現金流量或財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
由於本公司在多個國家設有營運據點，因此經濟、法規及政治環境的變動、自然災害、疫情或衝突可能對本公司營業成果產生不利影響。
本公司所處市場若出現持續性高通貨膨脹，可能會導致營運及融資成本上升，並導致本公司產品需求減少。
與煙草及尼古丁產品相關的訴訟可能大幅降低我們的獲利能力，並可能嚴重影響我們的流動性。
我們偶爾會因各種事項而受到政府機構的調查。
我們可能無法充分保護我們的智慧財產權，與智慧財產權相關的爭議可能對我們的業務造成損害。
非娛樂用途的鴉片類產品的研究、開發與商業化，使本公司面臨法律、監管、聲譽及其他風險。
我們在業務中越來越使用基於人工智慧的解決方案，這可能會導致聲譽損害、法律責任，並不利於我們的營運成果。
我們可能無法成功識別、完成或實現戰略收購、出售、合資企業或投資的效益。
paragraphs: 下列風險因素應謹慎閱讀，以評估本公司業務及本年度報告表10-K中所包含的前瞻性陳述。任何下列風險都可能對本公司業務、營運結果、財務狀況及本年度報告表10-K中所做前瞻性陳述的實際結果造成重大不利影響。
前瞻性與警示聲明
本公司有時會做出書面或口頭的前瞻性陳述，包括本年度報告表10-K及向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的其他檔案、向投資人報告及新聞稿與投資人網路簡報中所包含的陳述。您可以透過使用如 "策略"、"預期"、"持續"、"計畫"、"預期"、"相信"、"將"、"追求"、"估計"、"意圖"、"預測"、"目標"、"預測" 等詞彙來辨識這些前瞻性陳述。您也可以透過這些陳述與歷史或目前事實無直接關聯來辨識。

本公司無法保證任何前瞻性陳述會實現，儘管我們認為在計畫與假設上已謹慎。未來結果的實現受到風險、不確定性與不正確假設的影響。若已知或未知的風險或不確定性實現，或基礎假設被證明不正確，實際結果可能與預期、估計或預測有重大差異。投資人應在考慮前瞻性陳述與是否投資或繼續持有本公司證券時，記住這一點。根據1995年私人證券訴訟改革法案的「安全港」條款，我們正在識別重要因素，這些因素個別或整體可能導致實際結果與任何前瞻性陳述中所包含的結果有重大差異；任何此類陳述均參考以下警示聲明。我們在本文件中詳細說明這些及其他我們所面臨的風險，特別是在第7項「業務環境」中。您應瞭解無法預測或識別所有風險因素。因此，您不應將以下內容視為對所有潛在風險或不確定性的完整討論。本公司不承諾更新任何我們可能不時做出的前瞻性陳述，除非在正常進行公開披露義務的範疇內。
本公司可能在現有及新市場中引入、商業化及成長無煙產品的努力失敗，且監管機構可能禁止或大幅限制這些產品的商業化或科學證據支持資訊與聲稱的傳播。
本公司戰略優先順序為持續引入、商業化及成長無煙產品（SFPs），如果這些努力在關鍵市場或系統性上失敗，可能對本公司財務結果與未來成長前景造成重大不利影響。如果其他市場參與者在這些努力上更成功，或本公司在具有競爭優勢的SFP類別受到與香煙或其他SFP類別相比不公平的規範，而與這些產品的科學證據無關，本公司可能處於競爭劣勢。此外，某些市場參與者的行為，例如不當
